searchText: How are things looking for the testing tomorrow? <@!758579010027782144> <@!489256758989029405> still in sync 🙂 ? <@!301186049323958275> I believe the same changes that were recently made to EIP-2930 in https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3260 also need to be applied to EIP-1559 here: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blame/master/EIPS/eip-1559.md#L44 If I'm not mistaken this is a consensus change and thus might impact any plans for testing tomorrow, ya? /cc <@!552133098075193354> (I guess it depends on the nature of the test, if it's load/throughput related then probably OK to proceed, but if it's correctness related maybe better to wait?) It's a throughput test that is already on an old version of the spec, but thanks for flagging <@!388751025789468672> ! For more context, <@!388751025789468672> see: https://hackmd.io/@timbeiko/1559-prelim-perf is anyone here a web3j developer ?
